messages:
Tom (Content): Quick draft for a field playcard — aiming at enterprise leads evaluating private deployments. Need a quick pass on messaging + the CTA. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123
Asha (Marketing): Nice start. Can we open with compliance + auditability first? that's the hook for security-first buyers. :eyes:
Miguel (Product): Agree. Also call out model pinning & rollout controls — customers ask about regressions during upgrades.
Lena (Sales): Sales ask: make CTA specific — 'Request a dedicated trial' or 'Talk to solutions engineering'. Also add a tiny SLA snapshot table so reps can quote quickly.
Jordan (Legal): Quick note: avoid explicit SLA numbers in external collateral. Use phrasing like "SLA-backed options with enterprise contracts" and link to the legal FAQ instead.
Tom (Content): Got it — will swap explicit numbers for "enterprise SLAs available" and add a link to the SLA doc. Draft of the three bullets below, please pick/Edit:

- Security-first private deployments: VPC + KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and optional on-prem packaging for regulated workloads.
- Predictable performance & economics: dedicated GPU pools, configurable autoscaling, and SLA-backed capacity tiers for production throughput.
- Operational continuity: model version pinning, canary rollouts, automatic fallbacks, and token-level observability for QA and cost controls.

Lena (Sales): Those bullets are great. For the snapshot table on the back page (1-row), suggested headings: Deployment mode | Typical replace time | Sales ask
Asha (Marketing): Also add a 1-line customer quote area — even a placeholder like "We moved inference to Redwood and cut costs 3x" helps conversion.
Miguel (Product): Add a tiny note about model compatibility: "Supports open models and Redwood-verified performance profiles" — helps with procurement checks.
Jordan (Legal): Also include the compliance badges we can publish (SOC2, ISO) — confirm copy with me before finalizing.
ops-bot: Link scanned: https://figma.com/file/abc123 — no access issues reported.
Tom (Content): Thanks all. I'll push a V2 in Figma by EOD with the compliance-first lead, soft SLA phrasing, and the single-row snapshot table. Ping me here for final approval. :thumbsup:
